title: Vampire Vape Shortz Blue Cocktail
description: A juicy-sweet fruit cocktail with a delicate strawberry aftertaste, Vampire Vape’s Blue Cocktail is an exquisite light and fruity vape that’s super-smooth and gently sweet and an effortlessly satisfying all-day vape, ideal for vapers with a sweet tooth. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
